title: Langa, Zone 5 (Teenage Vuso St, approx.): 2 men, 20 and 25, shot dead in parked car, 12 Oct
summary: Two men aged 20 and 25 were shot dead and a third wounded while sitting in a parked vehicle on Teenage Vuso Street, Zone 5, Langa, on Monday evening 12 October; police registered two counts of murder and one of attempted...
story: Two men aged 20 and 25 were shot dead and a third wounded while sitting in a parked vehicle on Teenage Vuso Street, Zone 5, Langa, on Monday evening 12 October; police registered two counts of murder and one of attempted murder, with no arrests (Voice of the Cape, 13 Oct; Cape Argus, 14 Oct, quoting police spokesperson Ndakhe Gwala).
incident: Mon 12 Oct 2026, evening ('Monday evening' in reports of 13-14 Oct; time not given)
location_note: Teenage Vuso Street, Zone 5, Langa (exact spot not given). The pin is on the street.
basis: Both reports quote the same community leader and police details; not fully independent.

provenance.note: Two outlets, one account. Cape Argus (14 Oct) repeats long passages of Voice of the Cape's 13 Oct report, including the same police and community quotes.

facts.label: Deaths
facts.claim: Two men, 20 and 25, dead; a third wounded.

sources.name: Ndakhe Gwala, SAPS spokesperson
sources.quote: found the bodies of two men, aged 20 and 25, inside a vehicle

sources.name: Voice of the Cape (unattributed line)
sources.quote: The victims were shot while inside a car on Monday evening in Teenage Vuso Street, Zone 5, Langa.

sources.name: Nomalungelo Bikitsha, Langa community leader
sources.quote: The incident happened around the time people were coming home from work. It was not even dark

facts.label: Place
facts.claim: Teenage Vuso Street, Zone 5, Langa (street level).

sources.name: Ndakhe Gwala, SAPS spokesperson
sources.quote: Police spokesperson Ndakhe Gwala confirmed that Langa police had registered two counts of murder and one count of attempted murder following the shooting in Teenage Vuso Street, Zone 5, Langa.

sources.name: Ndakhe Gwala, SAPS spokesperson
sources.quote: The deceased had sustained multiple gunshot wounds to their upper bodies.

facts.label: Reported motive
facts.claim: Under police investigation; community leader calls it targeted.
facts.detail: The community leader says the perpetrators 'knew exactly what they were doing and who they were looking for'; Cape Argus turns this into 'a targeted ambush' in its first line.

sources.name: Ndakhe Gwala, SAPS spokesperson
sources.quote: The motive for the attack is the subject of a police investigation

sources.name: Nomalungelo Bikitsha, Langa community leader
sources.quote: We do not know what could have caused the shooting

facts.label: Legal status
facts.claim: Two murder counts and one attempted murder; no arrests.

sources.name: Ndakhe Gwala, SAPS spokesperson
sources.quote: no arrests have been made at this stage
